packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates automerge during the Monday 00:00-07:59 UTC window. The previous "on monday before 8 day of the month" was a day-of-month constraint, not a time of day, so it opened only on Mondays falling in the first week and a patch released on the 9th waited weeks.
Keep the Kubb packages moving together; 4.37.x had codegen bugs.
Workspace packages are linked, not published; never update them.

Except @jitaspace/db-builds, which jovespace (the history DB's writer and schema owner) publishes to npm. Take its updates as soon as they're released, in their own PR, so the /history reader never lags the schema; the schema contract test and type-check gate them.

pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides @opentelemetry/api to ~1.9.1 because Sentry v10 runs on OpenTelemetry SDK v2 (getsentry/sentry-javascript#25717). Sentry v11 needs api 1.10 + SDK v3, and the override also rewrites peer ranges, so `pnpm peers check` stays green on a v11 PR whose tracing is broken. Remind the reviewer on the PR itself.
prBodyNotes:
> [!WARNING]
> **Check the `@opentelemetry/api` override before merging.** `pnpm-workspace.yaml` pins `@opentelemetry/api` to `~1.9.1` for Sentry v10 (OpenTelemetry SDK v2, see getsentry/sentry-javascript#25717). If this release needs api 1.10 / SDK v3, the override silently forces 1.9.1 and also rewrites peer ranges, so `pnpm peers check` will NOT flag it. If `@trigger.dev/core` still pins api 1.9.1 / otel core 2.x, hold this PR: there is no single API version both can share. Otherwise drop the override in this PR and confirm there is exactly one copy: `find node_modules -path '*@opentelemetry/api/package.json' -not -path '*/dist/compiled/*'`.

packageRules.description: The other half of the @opentelemetry/api override's removal condition: it can go only once trigger.dev is off OpenTelemetry SDK v2 too.
prBodyNotes:
> [!NOTE]
> `pnpm-workspace.yaml` overrides `@opentelemetry/api` to `~1.9.1`, partly because `@trigger.dev/core` pins api 1.9.1 and otel core 2.x. If this release moves to api 1.10 / OpenTelemetry SDK v3 and Sentry is already on v11, the override can be removed. Check with `npm view @trigger.dev/core@<new version> dependencies`.
